gaps.sentence: They put ___ the meeting until everyone could attend.
She keyed ___ the password and logged on.
gaps.explanation: key in = type in (a password, code).

gaps.sentence: I can't figure ___ how this app works.
They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
He stole the pens and got away ___ it.
gaps.explanation: get away with something = do wrong without being punished.

gaps.sentence: I'll pay you ___ as soon as I get paid.
gaps.explanation: pay somebody back = return borrowed money; pay off a debt = finish paying it.

gaps.sentence: Hurry ___ or we'll miss the ferry!
The bonus made up ___ all the overtime we had done.
gaps.explanation: make up FOR something = compensate for it.
